title: 機械工作法
subtitle: Manufacturing process and systems
keywords: Machining methods 2.Machine tools 3.Tool damage 4.Cutting force and cutting temperature 5.Dimensional and shape accuracy
educationalGoal: Knowledge of the basic properties of materials, design techniques, and processing techniques is indispensable to manufacturing machine parts. Students will: (1) learn the functions and structures of various machine tools (2) learn how to select an advantageous machining method for the requirements under the basic production manufacturing technology (3) learn how to measure cutting force and cutting edge temperature
advice: This course deals with the basics of fundamental machining methods, and with understanding the functions and structures of various machine tools. 1. Outline of manufacturing technology 2. Basics of forming 3. Milling operation 4. Turning operation 5. Drilling operation 6. Grinding operation 7. Basis for chip formation measurement method and quality control 8. Basics of cutting force and cutting temperature measurement 9. Effects of tool damage on finished surface
books: Textbooks: Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to watch videos on machining methods and the functions of machine tools. This will help you understand actual machine motion and machining systems. It is also important to experience the actual machining process by visiting processing plants and industrial fairs.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the processing method for forged material
Be able to understand the functions and structures of various machine tools
Be able to understand basic manufacturing methods
Be able to select an advantageous processing method with sufficient accuracy form basic manufacturing technology
Be able to understand the measurement methods used to verify the required accuracy

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Accurately explain the method of forming materials. (2) Fully understand the functions and structures of various machine tools. (3) Explain basic manufacturing methods correctly. (4) An advantageous manufacturing method can be selected to realize sufficient accuracy to the drawings. (5) Explain the measurement method to accurately verify the accuracy required for the machined parts.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Explain the method of forming materials. (2) Understand the functions and structures of various machine tools. (3) Explain basic manufacturing methods. (4) An advantageous manufacturing method can be selected which achieves the required accuracy to the drawings. (5) Explain the measurement method to verify the specified dimensions of machined parts.
